title: Geometrically-Constrained Radar-Inertial Odometry via Continuous Point-Pose Uncertainty Modeling
rationale: Joint point and pose uncertainty qualifies radar weighting under sparse noisy returns; navigation recovery is not established by the abstract.

title: Range-Aided LiDAR-Inertial Multi-Vehicle Localization and Mapping in Degenerate Environments
rationale: Range observations correct the detected degeneracy direction and support shared pose graphs; centralized exchange and range geometry need source review.

title: Robust Ground Constrained SLAM for Mobile Robot With Sparse-Channel LiDAR
rationale: Ground-normal constraints and intensity features directly address sparse-channel corridor degeneracy; ground validity and task effects remain to be read.

title: WING: Wheel-Inertial Neural Odometry With Ground Manifold Constraints
rationale: Interoceptive wheel/IMU odometry supplies a complementary fallback when external sensing degrades; learned corrections and continuous-ground assumptions need qualification.

title: AirSLAM: An Efficient and Illumination-Robust Point-Line Visual SLAM System
rationale: Joint point/line features and map reuse address illumination and relocalization with reported embedded deployment; timing and failure protocols require full text.

title: CMRNext: Camera to LiDAR Matching in the Wild for Localization and Extrinsic Calibration
rationale: Cross-modal correspondence and pose estimation test sensor/setup transfer in localization and calibration; this does not establish map-change safety.

title: Chamelion: Reliable Change Detection for Long-Term LiDAR Mapping in Transient Environments
rationale: Online change detection and map maintenance target transient construction/office structure, with synthetic change training and alignment assumptions to inspect.

title: E2-BKI: Evidential Ellipsoidal Bayesian Kernel Inference for Uncertainty-Aware Gaussian Semantic Mapping
rationale: Evidential semantics, observation aggregation and geometry-aligned kernels add uncertainty calibration evidence for outdoor maps; downstream control remains separate.

title: Multi-Session Mapping and Long-Term Localization for Autonomous Vehicles Using Radar
rationale: Multi-session radar alignment, loop verification and persistent-point maintenance directly inform weather-tolerant map validity; evidence is dataset-based in the abstract.

title: OMCL: Open-Vocabulary Monte Carlo Localization
rationale: Open-vocabulary likelihoods support cross-modal and language-initialized localization; map construction and ground-robot transfer require source inspection.

title: LiDAR Teach, Radar Repeat: Robust Cross-Modal Navigation in Degenerate and Varying Environments
rationale: Cross-modal teach/repeat and error-driven adaptation address weather and structural change over sustained operation; teaching, adaptation and hardware costs need reading.

title: Super4DR: 4-D Radar-Centric Self-Supervised Odometry and Gaussian-Based Map Optimization
rationale: Radar self-supervision and Gaussian map refinement extend adverse-condition sensing comparisons; visually assisted map assumptions and executed actions remain unverified.

title: A Terrain-Adaptive $\epsilon$-Constraint MPC for Uneven Terrain Kinodynamic Planning
rationale: Terrain-conditioned objective bounds and sparse-GP dynamics jointly shape car-like planning; reported percentages are not adopted before reading the experiment protocol.

title: MonoMPC: Monocular Vision Based Navigation With Learned Collision Model and Risk-Aware Model Predictive Control
rationale: Learned action-conditioned clearance distributions drive risk-aware control and reported hardware navigation; calibration scope and collision protocol need full text.

title: Off-Road Navigation via Implicit Neural Representation of Terrain Traversability
rationale: Continuous traversability gradients jointly optimize route geometry and speed for vibration-sensitive off-road navigation; evaluation details are not in the abstract.

title: HEIGHT: Heterogeneous Interaction Graph Transformer for Robot Navigation in Crowded and Constrained Environments
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
rationale: Heterogeneous temporal interactions include pedestrians and static constraints, with simulation/hardware domain-shift tests; uncertainty and safety calibration remain open.

title: Safe Trajectory Generation for Nonholonomic Multi-Robot Systems: A Compensation-Based MPC Approach
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
rationale: Online discrepancy estimation and barrier/stability constraints address uncertain nonholonomic team motion; adaptive constraint feasibility needs source verification.

title: SCOPE: Stochastic Cartographic Occupancy Prediction Engine for Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic Navigation
rationale: Stochastic occupancy prediction connects robot/object motion and static structure to executed uncertainty-aware navigation; calibration and timing denominators require reading.

title: CoCoPlan: Adaptive Coordination and Communication for Multi-Robot Systems in Dynamic and Unknown Environments
rationale: Joint task allocation and intermittent rendezvous planning directly addresses connectivity restoration; claimed scale and hardware scope must be separated in full text.

title: Communication-Robust Asynchronous Distributed LiDAR Collaborative Smoothing and Mapping
rationale: Asynchronous distributed pose optimization and compact loop descriptions address delay and packet loss; consistency and loss models need source inspection.

title: Feedback-Guided Hierarchical Transmission for Multi-Robot Mapping Under Bandwidth Constraints
rationale: Feedback selects pose, geometry and semantic transmission layers under bandwidth/loss tests; dataset replay and estimated collision risk are explicit limitations.

title: URGE: Efficient Decentralized Multirobot Exploration Guided by Unknown Regions Under Limited Communication
rationale: Regional abstractions and load-aware allocation reduce redundant exploration and communication, with hardware tests; reconnection acceptance remains to be read.

title: riMESA: Consensus ADMM for Real-World Collaborative SLAM
rationale: Robust incremental consensus ADMM addresses outliers and limited communication in online collaborative estimation; downstream navigation is not established by the abstract.

title: MEF-Explore: Communication-Constrained Multi-Robot Entropy-Field-Based Exploration
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
rationale: Entropy-driven exploration and rendezvous use distinct low/high rate links; always-available position exchange must qualify any partition-resilience interpretation.

title: Sem-NaVAE: Semantically-Guided Outdoor Mapless Navigation via Generative Trajectory Priors
rationale: Generative path proposals, lightweight open-vocabulary scoring and a local planner add an explicit semantic-to-action interface with outdoor trials.

title: VAMOS: A Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Model for Capability-Modulated and Steerable Navigation
rationale: A separate embodiment affordance model filters semantic plans and is tested on wheeled and legged robots; training and embodiment limits need source review.

title: osmAG-LLM: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation via Semantic Maps and Large Language Models Reasoning
rationale: Semantic context and active search explicitly address moved or unmapped objects, qualifying dense-map freshness assumptions; physical safety remains separate.

title: VLN-Game: Vision-Language Equilibrium Search for Zero-Shot Semantic Navigation
rationale: Object-centric mapping and game-theoretic target disambiguation extend attribute-rich goals; simulation and robot deployment evidence need separate reading.

title: OLiVia-Nav: An Online Lifelong Vision Language Approach for Mobile Robot Social Navigation
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
rationale: Online distillation of social VLM features into a lightweight navigator addresses adaptation and compute placement; social outcome and forgetting protocols need reading.

title: NORM-Nav: Zero-Shot Mobile Robot Navigation with Natural Language Behavioral Constraints
venue: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
rationale: Language constraints grounded in vision/LiDAR become directional and speed costmap layers compatible with geometric planners; feasibility and latency need source review.

title: Design and Implementation of Cloud–Edge Collaborative Mapping and Control System for Mobile Robots
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
rationale: Cloud/edge mapping and control with service orchestration adds deployment and offloading evidence; network failure handling is not established by the abstract.

title: A Coordinated Approach to Control Mechanical and Computing Resources in Mobile Robots
rationale: Measured wheeled-robot energy co-management couples speed and CPU settings, addressing joint mechanical/computational resource costs.

title: Help Me Through: Imitation Learning Based Active View Planning to Avoid SLAM Tracking Failures
rationale: Active view planning targets tracking failure at texture-poor transitions and discloses substantial human-supervised training; deployment and intervention scope need reading.

title: Multirobot Persistent Monitoring: Minimizing Latency and Number of Robots With Recharging Constraints
rationale: Recharging-constrained persistent monitoring links service latency and fleet size; graph/solver evidence is distinct from physical long-term deployment.

title: R-FAC: Resilient Value Function Factorization for Multirobot Efficient Search With Individual Failure Probabilities
rationale: Value factorization explicitly handles changing team membership caused by robot failure and includes a hardware proof of concept; failure probabilities require qualification.

title: RADIUM: Predicting and Repairing End-to-End Robot Failures Using Gradient-Accelerated Sampling
rationale: Failure prediction and design/policy repair connect testing with response generation; transferable mechanisms span mixed embodiments and simulated/hardware evidence.
